name: carbonaltdelete-skills
description: Carbon+Alt+Delete MCP connector with skills for sustainability consultants: the CADdy companion, project diarist, support and custom-field workflows.

interface.longDescription: Work on corporate carbon footprints in Carbon+Alt+Delete. The plugin connects to your Carbon+Alt+Delete account and adds skills for sustainability consultants: set up companies, organizational units, reporting periods, and activity categories; review inventory data; search and map emission factors; plan reductions with simulations and benchmarks; manage custom fields; and keep a project diary of decisions and assumptions. Requires a Carbon+Alt+Delete account. The assistant acts as you, sees only the companies you can access, and cannot delete data.
defaultPrompt: Which companies can I access, and which reporting periods do they have?
Find an emission factor for diesel burned in company cars.
Map my procurement export to emission factors and flag uncertain matches.
